pages.text: $(bold)Heavenly Restriction: Cursed Energy$() — the binding opposite to the "Tyrant": sacrifice your $(bold)flesh$() in exchange for surging Cursed Energy.$(br2)Conditions to trigger (all must be met):$(li)Full moon night (moon phase 0, night 13000~23000)$(li)Open sky: nothing may cover the pool directly above$(li)Light level at the ritual spot > 8 (a bright place)$(li)Pool: 1 block deep, at least 9 connected water source blocks, with open space right above the pool's center$(br2)In Creative mode the time condition can be skipped for easier testing.

Within 16 blocks of the pool, prepare the altar materials:$(li)Netherrack ×7 or more$(li)Crying Obsidian ×9 or more (unlike the Tyrant's obsidian)$(li)Soul Sand ×7 or more$(li)Quartz Blocks ×9 or more (unlike the Tyrant's nether bricks)$(li)Light $(bold)fire$() on the netherrack and $(bold)soul fire$() on the soul sand (at least 1 of each)$(br2)The ritual spot needs light level > 8: on a full moon night the open-air lighting is limited, so arranging the fires/lights along the pool's edge is enough to satisfy it.

Steps:$(li)1. Gather the materials and light the fires$(li)2. Throw a $(bold)Cursed Energy Core$() of any kind into the pool water (it is consumed by the ritual): the core is drawn into the pool's center, spins for 3 seconds, then scatters as the pool glows white$(li)3. Jump into the pool: every 20 ticks the pool "heals −11% of max health" (direct damage that ignores armor and invulnerability frames), with heavy white block-break particles, until your health is down to just 1%$(li)4. Darkness falls and the center of the screen shows "Heavenly Restriction", "Cursed Energy", "You have mastered Cursed Energy" in turn; glass shattering and a wither death sound play; then the pool drains, the fires go out, and your health recovers to 40% of the new maximum

Upon completion you gain $(bold)Heavenly Restriction: Cursed Energy$():$(li)Weakened body: max health / movement speed / attack damage each ×0.5 (permanent attributes)$(li)Cursed Energy affinity: innate $(bold)+200$()$(li)While wearing a Cursed Energy Core: total Cursed Energy and Cursed Energy output each automatically gain $(bold)+1$() level$(br2)This state is $(bold)locked in$(): neither death nor relogging removes it.$(bold)Ritual detection$(): mutually exclusive with the "Tyrant" ritual — completing either binding ritual puts a mark on you, and while marked neither ritual can be held again; use the command $(bold)/tinkersnewlife unbind$() to clear the mark and restore your physique and attributes. The Cursed Energy Core thrown into the pool is consumed, so you will need to obtain a new core to wear and enjoy the bonuses.
